data.gender_notes: Gasperoni is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Italian name Gasparo, which originated from the Persian name Gaspar. The name Gaspar means 'treasurer' or 'bringer of treasure' in Persian. In the biblical story of the Magi, Gaspar is one of the three wise men who visited the baby Jesus. The name Gasperoni carries the meaning “Gas, Treasurer” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gasperoni usually hope their child will grow to embody gas, treasurer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
